name: Resonex-PE
description: A quantum-lattice copper-beryllium-vanadium alloy engineered to exhibit perfectly elastic mechanical behavior — 100% energy return under deformation — by eliminating all dislocation pathways and grain boundaries through atomic-precision assembly, resulting in a single-crystal structure at macroscopic scale. Where conventional metals dissipate kinetic energy as heat through plastic deformation, Resonex-PE stores and returns it entirely through reversible lattice compression. The material can undergo millions of full-amplitude deformation cycles without fatigue, provided deformation remains within its defined elastic envelope.
story_hooks: A Tier 2 underground fighting circuit has a champion whose prosthetic legs are rumored to contain Resonex-PE springs — she's unbeatable and the betting syndicates want to know if it's the metal or the woman, and are willing to pay to find out.

Tessera Materials discovers a batch of Resonex-PE has developed a harmonic resonance frequency that coincidentally matches a critical structural frequency in a particular model of transit bridge — and there are forty-seven of those bridges in active use.

A black-market weapons dealer is offering custom blade stock made from Resonex-PE — a knife that returns every joule of impact force back through the handle, which is either an incredible weapon or a liability that will shatter the wielder's wrist.
